_: Source of truth for the Andean Road colour layer. Edit this, then run `npm run tokens`.
_neutralSource: Inca gold — the same hue as --brand-gold in map-tokens.css. Only its HUE is used; chroma is crushed to a whisper so the greys read as warm paper (#FAFAF8), not beige. This is what keeps 'warm paper undertone' (DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §4) true by construction instead of by hand-picking.
_contrastTargets: Floors, enforced by the build. text is 13.0 rather than the AAA 7.0 on purpose: primary text on this site measured 15.9:1 and reads as ink, not as dark grey. Dropping it to 7.0 passes WCAG and still looks wrong. text-2/text-3 were 4.63:1 and 4.54:1 by hand — thin enough that DESIGN-SYSTEM.md warns not to touch them; they now have real headroom.
